name: comp-303
blurb: Dark upgrade prompt banner with icon, message, divider, and upgrade link.
description: Full-width dark-themed banner with icon, feature description, divider separator, and linked upgrade call-to-action.
use_when: You need to prompt users to upgrade with a prominent, dark, full-width banner.
avoid_when: For non-upgrade prompts or modal-style interactions; use appropriate component instead.
a11y: Icon is aria-hidden. Upgrade link is keyboard accessible. No animation.
